content:
anya: quick follow-up from the autoscaler RFC thread — can we sketch out a concrete behavior for 'quota banking' + an elastic prewarm pipeline? seeing repeated p95 spikes for tenant bursts and want a predictable, budgeted way to absorb them :wave:
miguel: sure. what's the exact problem we want to solve vs current autoscaler? is it scale latency, overprovisioning, or noisy neighbors during bursts?
sam: tl;dr: scale latency + cost. Some tenants have steady baseline but occasional short spikes (30s-3m). autoscaler ramps too slowly; we either pay for always-on headroom or we accept 2-10s p95 heatups. quota banking idea = let tenants accumulate short-term 'credit' from unused reserved throughput and spend it when they burst.
jess: curious about fairness/gaming. how do we prevent a tenant from hoarding credits or gaming start/stop to build bank? also need clear bounds for SLOs tied to commit level.
sam: agree — we limit via cap + decay. basic rules i propose: 1) earn rate = commit_units * earn_factor per minute (configurable), 2) max_balance = commit_units * max_multiplier, 3) credits decay if unused for X minutes, 4) spending limited to a per-burst cap and global cluster-safety cap. example config snippet: ```yaml
banking: 
  earn_factor: 0.5    # 50% of commit replenishes per minute
  max_multiplier: 6   # can bank up to 6x commit
  decay_minutes: 60   # balance decays after 60m idle
  per_burst_spend_pct: 0.8 # can spend up to 80% of balance at once
```
miguel: mental model: credits are soft headroom tokens that convert to immediate admission rights (start prewarm nodes or steal from burst lane). we need admission surface: when a request arrives and no idle slot, check token balance and either (A) trigger fast prewarm path (best-effort) or (B) allocate burst slot with higher cost charge + metric event. also need a safety valve to prevent cluster overload: global_bank_reserve that pauses spending when cluster pressure > threshold.
anya: good. couple questions: 1) how does this interact with reservation contracts (dedicated commitments)? 2) what happens on prewarm failure (quota exhausted or provisioning timed out)? 3) can we simulate the economics impact before rolling out?
jess: for reservations: tie earn rate to committed GPU-seconds (so enterprise customers with reserved capacity earn faster/more). for prewarm failure we must have graceful fallback: either degrade to hosted pool (if tenant allowed), fallback to smaller model, or start shedding low-priority requests. fallback policy should be explicit in tenant config. also surface a clear billing event for credit spend vs explicit bursts.
miguel: signals for prewarm trigger: recent_qps_derivative > threshold, backlog_tokens > X, tail_latency trend rising, and model-hotness flag (cache hit ratio low). preferred order: forecast -> credit check -> prewarm -> admit. forecast can be a simple EWMA of qps derivative to start.
sam: here's a rough admission pseudo-policy to put in the autoscaler DSL: ```json
{
  "admit_policy": {
    "forecast_window_s": 30,
    "bank_check": {
      "min_balance": 1,
      "max_spend_pct": 0.8
    },
    "prewarm": {
      "mode": "best_effort",
      "timeout_s": 15,
      "fallback": ["hosted_pool","smaller_model","reject"]
    }
  }
}
```
ops-bot: deploy-bot: autoscaler-v2 branch pushed to dev; canary rollout scheduled for next dev window (noon PT) :robot_face:
jess: observability reqs: emit per-tenant events for earn/spend (amount, reason, remaining_balance), prewarm_start/finish/timeout, fallback_reason. also expose synthetic load sim dashboard so SRE can validate behavior. without these we won't be comfortable enabling banking for prod tenants.
miguel: i'll prototype a simulator this week to model bank earn/spend under traces we have (10k tenants sample). timeline: sim + metrics dashboard -> add admission hooks -> short canary -> extended soak. want owners?
anya: thanks — miguel owns sim, sam will draft the autoscaler DSL PR and add the prewarm + fallback hooks, jess will spec observability events and billing mapping. i'll follow up with infra on cluster safety thresholds and set up a short sync after the sim is ready. closing loop here unless more comments. :+1:
